newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran president's quotes on domestic, foreign issues.
newsitem.headline: Iran president's quotes on domestic, foreign issues.

text.p: Following are excerpts from the inauguration speech by Iranian President Mohammad Khatami before parliament during his swearing-in ceremony on Monday.
The 54-year-old Shi'ite Moslem cleric, elected with nearly 70 percent of the vote in May, took office with a mandate for social and economic change.

Oath of office -- "I as the president of the Islamic Republic of Iran swear before the holy Koran and the Iranian nation and God to be the guardian of the official religion, the Islamic Republic and the constitution."
Domestic agenda -- "Looking after the people's living conditions is a principle vital for the survival and well-being of the system."

"Protecting freedom and respect for the rights of people, expansion and deepening of a civil society, preventing violation of legal rights and liberties and provide freedom of expression and comfort of mind for every individual."
"Public participation in running of the state affairs is a must and legitimises the government."
Foreign affairs -- "My government considers dialogue between civilisations in the present world essential and will avoid any action or behaviour causing tension."

"We will have relations with any government that observes our independence, meaning the decisions made within our national interests...But we will resist any power wishing to exercise dominance over us."
"It is particularly important for the government to...defend the rights of Moslems and deprived people of the world, particularly the innocent nation of Palestine."
"The presence of a proud, cultivated and independent Iran at the heart of the world community is the dream of all noble and responsible Iranians."
